chapter: Floods, Mardi Gras and street music
title: Floods and water moccasins
summary: Flood water entered houses in her girlhood, bringing snakes she calls Kong.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Do you remember any of the big floods when you were a girl? Was there water in the houses?

Plenty, plenty of water. Plenty, plenty. See, they didn't have no sewage. The Kong, what do they call it, Kong? Blind Eel, I believe they called them. Big, big moccasins or something like that. Oh, yes. Yeah, they're poisonous. But sometimes the water would come to the door and then things would get out of the door. What's the name? And come in the house.
Water moccasins. Yeah. We called them Kong in French.
